why: Both proposals share the same sofa (charcoal grey rather than the dark green velvet requested), rug, table, mirror and lamp. They differ only in the armchairs: A's curved, clean-lined wingbacks sit more comfortably with the soft, traditional look of the room, while B's nailhead wingbacks are slightly more formal and heavier. The A pair is also a little more compact, which helps around the fireplace.
